messages:
Maya R: Quick summary — I've pulled together the postmortem action items for the GPU surge on 2026-03-12 and turned them into a closure playbook. Please review and claim items by EOD Friday. Link: https://redwood.internal/pm/gpu-surge-20260312

Igor P: Taking the scheduler tuning work. I'll prototype a conservative change and run it in staging. Draft patch:
```
# scheduler config
max_preemptable_pods: 10
pod_priority_saturation_window: 120s
slot_size_override: 0.8
```
Will test on canary pool Tue

Samir K: I'll own quota backstop. Plan:
- add soft quota alerts at 85% per region
- implement emergency lease policy for burst >90%
ETA: Wed EOD for alerts, Thu for policy PR

Jess L: I'll lead headroom planning and runbook updates. Noted recurring 02:00-04:00 UTC surge. Proposed steps:
1) increase baseline headroom to 12% for eu-west1, us-west2
2) add pre-emptive warm-up jobs during predicted spikes
Meeting requested to align with scheduling team: Thu 10:30 PT

Maya R: Thanks. We should also add a validation eval (latency/cost) post-change and a rollback window. Owning that?

Igor P: I can add the eval harness. Will target same canary run.

ops-bot: Reminder — follow-up meeting scheduled Thu 2026-03-19 17:30 UTC. Attendees: @Maya R, @Igor P, @Jess L, @Samir K

Samir K: added the alert dashboards and the lease PR is in draft: https://git.redwood/ops/quota-lease/pull/42

Jess L: Added runbook patch, link in the playbook doc.

Maya R: Ok let's close items once PRs merged + canary green. Please post status updates in this thread when each is done. :thumbsup:

Igor P: sgtm :thumbsup:

Jess L: will update after runbook merge

Samir K: closing alerts now
